description_blocks.text: Making elaborate miniature models of tourbillons, gearboxes, engineering machinery and bionic toys only to find that the strength, stiffness, tolerance and smoothness of the printed shaft system are not up to expectations? This Precision Shaft System Kit contains multiple sizes of miniature deep groove ball bearings, thrust ball bearings, bronze bushings and pins, which help to solve the strength and accuracy problems in designing the shaft system and linear motion of small-sized models. Take your miniature model to the next level.

Miniature shaft system: Use metal shafts and bearings as rotating shafts when making gearboxes and other shaft systems to improve shaft parallelism and stability of shaft distance and reduce rotating resistance.
Miniature Linkage: Use thrust ball bearings and shoulder screws to improve parallelism between linkages for smoother reciprocating motion.
Miniature carriage: Use miniature bearings to make the carriage, reduce the resistance of linear movement.
Miniature guide: Use metal shaft and copper sleeve to make miniature guide, which makes the linear motion of the model free from the interference of layer lines and smoother and more stable.
Miniature hinge: Use metal shaft as the miniature hinge shaft to improve the strength and rigidity of the model's shaft.

description_html:
Documentation



3D Model

 

Overview


Making elaborate miniature models of tourbillons, gearboxes, engineering machinery and bionic toys only to find that the strength, stiffness, tolerance and smoothness of the printed shaft system are not up to expectations? This Precision Shaft System Kit contains multiple sizes of miniature deep groove ball bearings, thrust ball bearings, bronze bushings and pins, which help to solve the strength and accuracy problems in designing the shaft system and linear motion of small-sized models. Take your miniature model to the next level.

 

Applications:

  • Miniature shaft system: Use metal shafts and bearings as rotating shafts when making gearboxes and other shaft systems to improve shaft parallelism and stability of shaft distance and reduce rotating resistance.
  • Miniature Linkage: Use thrust ball bearings and shoulder screws to improve parallelism between linkages for smoother reciprocating motion.
  • Miniature carriage: Use miniature bearings to make the carriage, reduce the resistance of linear movement.
  • Miniature guide: Use metal shaft and copper sleeve to make miniature guide, which makes the linear motion of the model free from the interference of layer lines and smoother and more stable.
  • Miniature hinge: Use metal shaft as the miniature hinge shaft to improve the strength and rigidity of the model's shaft.
